messages.subject: which column is Num_Probes in the segment file ?
messages.subject_clean: which column is Num_Probes in the segment file ?
messages.body_plain:
Hello, I have read the manuscript - Sequenza:
allele-specific copy number and mutation profiles from tumor sequencing data.
By following the manuscript, I have called allele-specific copy number with
Sequenza R pakcage, I want to compare the ploidy and cellularity results
estimated by Sequenza with ABSOLUTE as the manuscript do. From the manuscript,
I know both methods used the same segment files. After inspecting the segment
files returned by sequenza, I find it hard to determine which column should be
used as the `Num_Probes` in ABSOLUTE. After Googling, I found this post (http://crazyhottommy.blogspot.com/2017/11/run-gistic2-with-sequenza-segmentation.html)
which used `N.BAF` column as the `Num markers` in GISTIC2, from the description
in sequenza official site, I found `N.BAF` means the number of observation to
compute Bf in the segment and I also observed ` N.ratio` indicates the number
of observation to compute depth.ratio in the segment which is more accurate to
regarded as the `Num_Probes` in ABSOLUTE.

Could you tell me the right way to compare the
sequenza with ABSOLUTE as the manuscript do ?

Thank you and best regards.
